name: claude-band
description: ClaudeBand: the prompt-cache clock with 5-hour, weekly and context gauges plus spend, above the prompt and in a pane (terminal, desktop, phone, VS Code).

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then LANG (Chinese when neither says); a language code pins one. Or run /cb lang <code>. auto 先看 Claude Code 的 language 设置，再看 LANG，都没有时用中文；也可以用 /cb lang <语言> 切换。

warnAt.title: Yellow at % used / 标黄阈值（已用 %）
warnAt.description: 5h, weekly and context turn yellow at this percent used. 5 小时、周限和上下文用到这个百分比时标黄。

alertAt.title: Red at % used / 标红阈值（已用 %）
alertAt.description: 5h, weekly and context turn red at this percent used. 用到这个百分比时标红。

paceMargin.title: Ahead of pace, points / 超前预期多少点标黄
paceMargin.description: A 5h or weekly window turns yellow early when its use runs this many points past the pace tick; 0 turns it off. 5 小时或周限比预期竖线超前这么多个百分点时提前标黄，0 表示关闭。
